_notes: Untrimmed source pixels of lionfish_a1.png (2336x1744, generated at 4:3 so the spines and fans fit). Peduncle alpha>128 profile: 321 px at x=488 narrowing to 180 px at x=576 (y 887-1066); the soft dorsal tip starts at x=584. The cut sits 4 px head-side of that minimum. fin = the whole pectoral fan, pivot at its root behind the gill; it reaches below the belly, so underlay_polygon (the body and anal fin under the fan) keeps body alpha and everything else under the fan is cut to open water. Extra layer spines = the dorsal spine crest, pivot mid-base on the back; its underlay is the body below the back line plus the spotted soft dorsal fin under the rear spines; it reaches ~30 px above the back line so the body keeps the spine roots and no background shows when the crest swings. The fan uses fill_axis vertical so the flank it uncovers continues the vertical bands.
